# Board reference

One line per icon: its code, its meanings (separated by /), and what its picture shows. A code stands for the whole icon with all its meanings.

A1: Object / Box. Picture: Cardboard box; question mark. Details: Packing tape.
A2: Human / Real / Historical. Picture: Man in top hat, black suit, bow tie; Egyptian woman in headdress and white robe. Looks like: Abraham Lincoln; Cleopatra.
A3: Work / Occupation. Picture: Construction worker in hard hat with shovel; businessman with briefcase; nurse in cap and uniform with red cross. Details: Hard hat; tank top; briefcase; glasses; red cross.
A4: Fauna / Animal. Picture: Octopus; small yellow bird (chick, duckling); ladybug; elephant.
A5: Literature / Writing / Book. Picture: Book; quill (feather pen). Details: Ink line.
A6: Cinema / Movie. Picture: Movie camera (old reel-to-reel).
A7: Television / Program / Show. Picture: Flat-screen TV showing a live news broadcast. Details: "LIVE" banner; news anchor; headline ticker; clock "13:37".
A8: Idea / Intelligence / Concept. Picture: Head in profile (silhouette); light bulb inside the head. Details: Light rays.
A9: Place – Country / World / Flag. Picture: Globe (Earth); flag on a pole. Details: Dashed route lines.
A10: Date / Event / Day. Picture: Tear-off calendar pages reading "1 APRIL", "2 APRIL", "3 APRIL". Looks like: April Fools' Day (the "1 APRIL" page).
A11: Seacraft / Naval / Swimming. Picture: Motor yacht; sailboat. Details: Anchor emblem on the yacht's hull; waves.
A12: Ground transportation / Road. Picture: Red sports car; motorcycle (dirt bike). Details: Tire tracks.
A13: Game / Toy. Picture: Teddy bear; die (dice); playing cards; toy soldier (green army man).
A14: Food / Eating / Edible. Picture: Plate of food: chicken drumstick, peas; fork; knife; glass. Details: Unclear yellow side dish (fries, potatoes, or pasta); the glass's contents are unclear.
B1: Human / Society / Group. Picture: Family: two adults and a child.
B2: Character / Fictional / Imaginary. Picture: Superhero in blue suit and red cape with "S" on chest; mermaid. Looks like: Superman.
B3: Hobby / Sport. Picture: Gamer holding a game controller; person wearing headphones; tennis player. Details: Music notes; tennis racket; tennis ball; cap.
B4: Flora / Plant / Nature. Picture: Tree; cactus (saguaro); red rose; wheat (ear of grain).
B5: Music / Song. Picture: Treble clef; music note (eighth note).
B6: Art / Sculpture – Painting / Drawing – Cartoon. Picture: Statue (classical armless woman); paint palette; paintbrush; pencil. Looks like: Venus de Milo. Details: Comic-strip panels with speech bubbles.
B7: Title / Brand / Name. Picture: Book with "???" on the cover; red soda can with "???". Looks like: Coca-Cola can (red with white wave).
B8: Expression – Quote / Talking / Words. Picture: Speech bubble. Details: Lines of text.
B9: Building / Monument / City. Picture: City skyline; skyscraper (glass tower); factory (sawtooth roof); small house; apartment building. Details: Windows.
B10: Celebration / Anniversary / Holiday. Picture: Christmas tree; wrapped gift (present) with bow; jack-o'-lantern (carved pumpkin); champagne glass. Details: Star on the tree; ornaments.
B11: Aircraft / Aerial / Flying. Picture: Airplane (jet); helicopter.
B12: Tool / Construction. Picture: Screwdriver; hammer.
B13: Clothing / Accessory / Costume. Picture: Tank top; sombrero; jeans; high-heeled shoe.
B14: House – Dwelling / Room / Domestic. Picture: House with red roof. Details: Chimney with smoke; windows; door; doormat.
